judge.rationale: The core implementation in `chatOrchestrator.ts` is clean and accurate, properly accumulating token counts across rounds while preserving `undefined` when no usage is reported and clarifying the hook signature with `totalUsage?: TurnUsageMetadata`. All acceptance criteria from the ticket are satisfied, including a true two-tool-round (three provider calls) test. However, instead of adding tests to the existing `ChatOrchestrator tool loop` suite in `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` like the reference, the candidate scattered tests across three new test files, placed a test helper (`usageTurnHarness.ts`) in the production `src/orchestration/` tree, and left `.lore/dod.md` tracked. Additionally, in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, the candidate documented the new `afterModelResponse` behavior under the `Measured semantics — out of scope` heading rather than moving it into the main specification section, and missed updating `CLAUDE.md` and `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md`.
